FN-RBQ6CYY-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 115
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Linda Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/16/2026
Senate Bill 115 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of certain local
governments by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in: 1) the cost of
vehicle repairs exempted from competitive bidding laws pursuant to the provisions of this bill,
and 2) the cost for vehicle repairs otherwise paid pursuant to existing competitive bidding
agreements.
Page 1
